description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the front panel control logic for a device, including LED brightness, blinking patterns, and power state management. It defines classes, methods, and external dependencies related to front panel indicators and configurations.

classes.name: CFrontPanel
classes.description: Main class managing front panel indicators, brightness, blinking patterns, and preferences.

classes.name: BlinkInfo
classes.description: Structure representing blinking pattern information for LEDs.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for CFrontPanel, initializes hardware and configurations if not already done.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::start
methods.description: Starts the front panel indicator updates and blinking.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::stop
methods.description: Stops blinking timer and halts front panel updates.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level for all indicators.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::getBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the current brightness level.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::setClockBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness for the clock display if enabled.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::getClockBrightness
methods.description: Gets the current clock display brightness.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::powerOnLed
methods.description: Turns on specified front panel LED indicators.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::powerOffLed
methods.description: Turns off specified front panel LED indicators.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::powerOffAllLed
methods.description: Turns off all front panel LEDs.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::powerOnAllLed
methods.description: Turns on all front panel LEDs.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::setLED
methods.description: Configures LED indicator color and brightness based on parameters.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::setBlink
methods.description: Configures blinking pattern for a specified LED indicator.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::getPreferences
methods.description: Returns current front panel preferences.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::setPreferences
methods.description: Saves preferences to persistent storage.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::loadPreferences
methods.description: Loads preferences from persistent storage.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::startBlinkTimer
methods.description: Starts blinking timer with specified repeat count.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::stopBlinkTimer
methods.description: Stops blinking timer.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::setBlinkLed
methods.description: Sets LED to a specific blinking pattern.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::onBlinkTimer
methods.description: Callback for blinking timer to toggle LEDs.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::set24HourClock
methods.description: Configures clock display format to 24-hour or 12-hour.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::is24HourClock
methods.description: Checks if clock is in 24-hour format.
